exposure: Immediate post-placental intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion
outcome: Complications (menstrual disturbances, vaginal discharge, lost string, misplaced device, expulsion)
cohort: Women who received immediate post-placental intrauterine contraceptive device insertion within 10 minutes of placenta delivery.
finding: Postpartum intrauterine contraceptive device was found to be an effective, acceptable contraceptive method with a low rate of complications.
mod_finding: Lost strings were more frequently observed in the caesarean section group compared to vaginal insertions, while other complications were comparable.
